hooks.text: Fruit first. *Sugar* second, if at all.
hooks.why: Same contrarian claim, shorter, order reversed.

hooks.text: Most jam is sugar with a *fruit* label.
hooks.why: Names the category's habit instead of the product's promise.

hooks.text: We cook *12 jars* per copper pan.
hooks.why: A sourced number in the contrarian frame.

hooks.text: If you taste the sugar first, it is *not jam*.
